bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for neighborhood partnership grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; EDUCATION PARTNERSHIP GRANTS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

Neighborhood partnership grants.

(a) For neighborhood partnership grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 124D.99:

$

2,600,000

.....

2026

$

2,600,000

.....

2027

(b) Of the amounts in paragraph (a), $1,300,000 each year is for the Northside Achievement Zone and $1,300,000 each year is for the St. Paul Promise Neighborhood.

(c) The base for fiscal year 2028 and later is $2,600,000. For purposes of the base for fiscal year 2028 and later, the allocations under paragraph (b) continue.

(d) Any balance in fiscal year 2026 is available in fiscal year 2027.

Subd. 3.

Regional neighborhood partnership grants.

(a) For regional neighborhood partnership grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 124D.99:

$

1,400,000

.....

2026

$

1,400,000

.....

2027

(b) Of the amounts in paragraph (a), $200,000 each year is for the following programs:

(1) Northfield Healthy Community Initiative in Northfield;

(2) Red Wing Youth Outreach Program in Red Wing;

(3) United Way of Central Minnesota in St. Cloud;

(4) Austin Aspires in Austin;

(5) Rochester Area Foundation in Rochester;

(6) Greater Twin Cities United Way for Generation Next; and

(7) Children First and Partnership for Success in St. Louis Park.

(c) The base for fiscal year 2028 and later is $1,400,000. For purposes of the base for fiscal year 2028 and later, the allocations under paragraph (b) continue.

(d) Any balance in fiscal year 2026 is available in fiscal year 2027.

Subd. 4.

Regional neighborhood partnership onetime grants.

(a) For onetime grants for regional neighborhood partnership:

$

$900,000

.....

2026

$

$900,000

.....

2027

(b) Of the amounts in paragraph (a), $100,000 each year is for the following programs:

(1) Northfield Healthy Community Initiative in Northfield;

(2) Red Wing Youth Outreach Program in Red Wing;

(3) United Way of Central Minnesota in St. Cloud;

(4) Austin Aspires in Austin;

(5) Rochester Area Foundation in Rochester;

(6) Greater Twin Cities United Way for Generation Next;

(7) Children First and Partnership for Success in St. Louis Park;

(8) Northside Achievement Zone; and

(9) St. Paul Promise Neighborhood.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation.

Subd. 5.

Emerging partnership grant.

(a) For emerging neighborhood partnership grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 124D.99:

$

.......

.....

2026

$

.......

.....

2027

(b) Grant money may be used for initial planning and development of education partnership program locations, including but not limited to organizational and planning functions to identify partners, community supports, and services. The commissioner of education must review proposals and award grants to programs that primarily serve historically underserved students. To the extent practicable, the commissioner must award grants equitably among the geographic areas of Minnesota, including rural, suburban, and urban communities. The submitted proposal for an emerging partnership grant must include evidence of: (1) readiness to pursue the activities required of an established partnership; and (2) adding geographic or demographic diversity to the education partnerships network.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation.
